name: Daphne Kontou

hotels, ferries, coaches, licensed guides and domestic flights, each confirmed in writing and reconfirmed before arrival.

bookings, seat changes and baggage claims by phone and at the counter, on two reservation systems.
rerouted passengers onto partner flights during cancellations, and arranged hotels for missed connections.
